outcome: Detection of critical congenital heart disease (CCHD)
Pulmonary atresia (PA) with ventricular septal defect (PA-VSD)
cohort: A full-term male infant who passed CCHD screening at approximately 24 hours after birth.
finding: A case of pulmonary atresia with ventricular septal defect (PA-VSD) was missed by pulse oximetry-based CCHD screening but subsequently detected by a loud systolic cardiac murmur during clinical examination.
